## Methodology
- Nexus Method: Idea + Linker + Idea
- 5 operational KPIs: Idea Generation, Structural Thinking, Recovery Ability, Problem Solving, Responsiveness

Full pricing section: https://studioinfinitycr.com/pricing.html
Full pricing section (anchor): https://studioinfinitycr.com/#pricing

## Para quién (target audience)
Infinity Studio CR is NOT an English academy. Private 1-on-1 operational coaching for people who understand English but freeze under pressure.

Ideal profiles:
- Call center / BPO / tech support candidates — need to pass interviews and perform from day one → ORT
- Remote workers with international teams — meetings, stakeholders, fast structured responses → ORT + Nexora
- Weak foundation — academies failed; need communication core before pressure → Foundations (Jill 24/7)
- Already speak — need high-volume role-play without hourly cost → Nexora Professional (30 days 24/7)
- Bilingual schools & institutions — ORT pilots for employability KPIs → Kamuk School case
- Municipalities / public sector — youth employability with documented outcomes → Goicoechea case

NOT for: A1-B2 certificates only, cheap group classes, grammar-only study, casual conversation without work pressure.

Full page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/para-quien.html
Section on homepage: https://studioinfinitycr.com/#who-its-for

## Success stories (documented)
Full page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/casos-de-exito.html
Homepage section: https://studioinfinitycr.com/#success-stories

### Goicoechea 2021 (public sector)
- Municipal call-center readiness pilot led by TU506 (legacy name → Infinity Studio CR), our founder as head instructor
- Metrics (Informe de Labores 2022, p.34): 90 started / 10 confirmed hires / 15 in application / 25 still in training
- Official PDF: https://transparencia.munigoicoechea.go.cr/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/INFORMEDELABORES2022.pdf
- Transparency portal: https://transparencia.munigoicoechea.go.cr/
- Municipal video (Facebook): https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=263792665317206
- Video title: JÓVENES QUE RECIBIERON CURSO DE INGLÉS YA TRABAJAN GRACIAS A ALIANZA DE MUNICIPALIDAD DE GOICOECHEA Y TU506

### Kamuk School (institutional ORT)
- ORT pilot for high-performance bilingual employability — NOT classroom English
- Kamuk School, Tibás, San José — Alice & Nexora, KPI tracking, KAM- institutional cohort
- Official site: https://kamukschool.ed.cr/
- Bilingual program: https://kamukschool.ed.cr/educacion_integral/
